items.question: What is the monthly storage fee under the Kestrel storage agreement?
items.answer: The monthly storage fee under the Kestrel storage agreement is EUR 4,000, as stated in the original agreement [1]. However, this amount was amended by Amendment No. 1 to the agreement, which changed the fee to EUR 4,600 [2]. The amendment took effect on 1 June 2026.

evidence.quote: Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,000, invoiced on the first business day of each month.
Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,600, invoiced on the first business day of each month.
evidence.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement

items.question: How much notice is needed to terminate the Kestrel storage agreement?
items.answer:
The Kestrel storage agreement can be terminated with sixty (60) days' written notice, according to Clause 5.2 of the Kestrel Storage Services Agreement [1].

There is no mention of a different notice period for termination in the other sources provided.

evidence.quote: Either party may terminate this Agreement on sixty (60) days' written notice.
